title: Operations V3 Single-Door Control-Plane Reset
purpose: Replace overlapping governance and behavior surfaces with one GPT-first bootstrap, one operating contract, one current-state selector and one lane registry without losing product work or historical evidence.
scope: inventory surfaces that can select work, grant authority, steer agent behavior, block/finalize execution, or present live current state
install operations/ as the canonical control plane
rewrite AIOC, application, GPT Project Source and executor entrypoints so they only redirect into the canonical door or are explicitly non-authoritative
classify remaining legacy surfaces as projection, validator, executor adapter, evidence, source reference, background or historical
prevent legacy current-state prose and executable V2 tooling from steering agents
separate executor availability from work authorization
preserve completed product/code/content/source work and historical evidence
validate contradictions and unauthorized live selectors fail closed
non_goals: repair the Windows Codex worker as a prerequisite for this migration
acceptance_criteria: AIOC has one canonical bootstrap at operations/BOOTSTRAP.md
AIOC has one canonical behavior contract at operations/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md
AIOC has one mutable current-state selector at operations/CURRENT.json
AIOC has one lane registry at operations/LANES.json
AIOC and application entry surfaces contain redirects/non-authority adapters and no independent current/next-work claims
known legacy selectors, behavior policies, runbooks and executable V2 validators are registered non-authoritative or fail closed
application legacy current-state files no longer advertise STAGE-A-A2 or another live next task
ChatGPT Project Source entry/reference files are OPS3-safe and route to the same door
ChatGPT Project custom-instruction cutover is owner-confirmed
repository validation proves the single-door invariants
MIB-17 remains preserved selected_not_started with no implementation authority after the OPS3 freeze is cleared

external_platform_actions.verification_boundary: Project custom-instruction mutation is not exposed through the repository or Project Files API; completion is recorded from the owner's explicit cutover confirmation.
The owner performed the Project UI replacement; the resulting Project Source set and rewritten contents were read and audited through the Project Files surface.

completion_rule: Satisfied: repository cutover is merged and verified, remaining V2 live-looking surfaces are retired, ChatGPT Project entry surfaces are owner-confirmed/audited, and the preserved MIB-17 selection remains unstarted and unauthorized.
